senses.gloss:
अले अले or अलेले, ind. unmeaning words
in the dialect of the demons or Piśācas, intro-
duced in plays, &c.
अलेपक अ-लेपक, अस्, इका, अम्, stainless.

अलेश अ-लेश, अस्, आ, अम्, not little, much,
large; (अम्), ind. not at all.
—अ-लेशैज (˚श-एज्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, firm, steady.

आ-लेखन, अस्, आ, अम्, scratching, painting; (अस्),
m., N. of a teacher; (ई), f. a brush, a pencil; (अम्),
n. scratching, writing, painting.

आ-लेख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be written, to be deline-
ated or painted; (अम्), n. a painting, writing.
—आले-
ख्य-लेखा, f. painting.
—आलेख्य-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्,
having nothing left but a painting, deceased.

आ-लेप, अस्, m. smearing, plastering, anointing;
liniment.
आ-लेपन, अम्, n. smearing, plastering; liniment.
